## CodeQL / Polynomial regular expression used on uncontrolled data

This [regular expression](1) that depends on [library input](2) may run slow on strings starting with 'user.roles.exists(' and with many repetitions of 'user.roles.exists('.
This [regular expression](3) that depends on [library input](2) may run slow on strings starting with 'user.roles.exists(,' and with many repetitions of '\t'.
This [regular expression](1) that depends on [library input](4) may run slow on strings starting with 'user.roles.exists(' and with many repetitions of 'user.roles.exists('.
This [regular expression](3) that depends on [library input](4) may run slow on strings starting with 'user.roles.exists(,' and with many repetitions of '\t'.

[Show more details](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/framework/security/code-scanning/824)
